_comment: Candidate sources for the public demo's seed bundle (issue #628). Every item built from these must still pass `python -m app.scripts.demo_seed validate`, and each source's licence page must be re-read and dated in license_checked_on when the bundle is built (docs-site/docs/operations/public-demo.md, 'Building the seed bundle'). Only the speech of people speaking in an official or professional public capacity is used; no private individual.

sources.name: NASA mission audio, briefings and NASA TV programmes
Voice of America news reports in several languages
sources.notes: VOA marks some segments as third-party material; use only reports produced by VOA staff, and no street interviews.

sources.name: NOAA and National Weather Service public briefings
Redaction showcase: a scripted clip voiced by the project team with invented names, numbers and addresses
sources.notes: Every personal detail is invented and the item is marked synthetic_pii: true.

excluded.name: AMI Meeting Corpus
excluded.reason: CC BY 4.0, but the speakers are private individuals; the demo carries no private individual's voice.
